job.title: Customer Service Manager
job.description:
Customer Service Manager

Leeds | £50,000 | Permanent, full time

A fast-growing, privately owned business in Leeds is looking to hire a Customer Service Manager to run its customer care team day to day.

The role is fully focused on the day-to-day operation of the Customer Care Centre. You’ll be measured on performance reporting, people leadership and culture, and the efficiencies you bring. Your job is to support and empower team leaders, raise standards and deliver excellent service.

The role

  • Lead the customer care operation through a team of team leaders.
  • Own performance and people matters within the team: absence, capability, conduct and development, dealt with and closed at your level.
  • Set the standard for how customer contacts are handled and hold the team to it.
  • Work with the operations leadership as the customer journey is mapped and rebuilt, and bring the team with you onto the new ways of working.

About you

  • You have managed in a contact centre, with team leaders reporting to you.
  • You deal with performance and people issues yourself and see them through.
  • You are comfortable in a growing business where processes are still being shaped.
  • Experience in essential services, distribution (D2C) within a regulated sector is useful.

Future growth

As the organisation grows, they want a leader who will enjoy raising standards, aligning teams and adding to an already brilliant culture. You’ll also work with Heads of and Directors on group-wide transformation projects and system investments, with plenty of opportunities to develop and contribute.

Salary and benefits

  • £50,000 base salary
  • Hybrid working: 3 days a week in the office
  • No weekend working
  • Pension
  • 25 days holiday plus bank holidays
  • Professional development
  • Social parties
  • State-of-the-art offices
  • An award-winning organisation

job.title: Customer Change Lead
job.description:
Customer Change Lead (Contract)


Liverpool, hybrid (2 days a week on site) | 6 months | £70,000 equivalent


We’re looking for a Customer Change Lead to take a busy customer operation and make it faster and simpler for the people it serves.

The service handles high volumes of applications and enquiries. The journey has too many hand-offs: emails pass between shared inboxes with no clear owner, the same errors come back again and again, and customers can wait days for an answer. New performance data now shows what each person handles. Your job is to use it to build a better service.


You’ll work alongside the senior leadership team, starting with one service area and a team of around 25, then take the same approach into the wider customer operation.


What you’ll do

This role is focused on elevating: Tech, People and Process.

  • Implementation of a new multi contact case system
  • Map the customer journey end to end and cut out the back and forth for customers and staff
  • Give every enquiry a clear owner and move the team towards same-day callbacks
  • Coach team managers to run their teams on the new measures
  • Get more from the systems the team already uses, and build the case for any changes
  • Hand over changes the managers can run once your contract ends


What you’ll bring

  • Leadership foundations, and evedance of successfully implementing change and success across the 3 key areas (people, tech and processes)
  • A track record leading change in a customer operation or contact centre
  • A commercial head: you can put a cost and a payback against each change
  • The confidence to challenge long-established ways of working and bring long-serving colleagues with you
  • Stakeholder skills that hold up at senior level
  • Experience of working to contracted SLAs is a plus
  • Availability to start without (or a short) notice period


The details

  • Start ASAP
  • 6-month contract, £70,000 equivalent day rate
  • Monday to Friday
  • Liverpool office, 2 days a week on site

job.title: Technology & Customer Insights Manager
job.description:
Technology and Customer Insight Manager

London, hybrid | Permanent | £60,000

Our client is a fast-growing, app-led consumer brand with a national estate and a membership offer. They want one person to own marketing’s platforms, customer data and performance reporting, and to turn that data into decisions for the commercial team.

The role

  • Business owner of the marketing platforms (HubSpot and a lifecycle tool such as Iterable or Braze), including the roadmap, automation and integrations
  • Customer data, segmentation and exclusions, kept compliant with GDPR and PECR alongside Legal
  • Reporting and attribution covering campaigns, membership, app engagement and retention
  • Practical recommendations on CRM, pricing, membership and partnerships
  • The main marketing contact for Technology and Data, writing clear requirements for integrations and data flows
  • Documenting processes and controls so the knowledge sits with the team

You’ll bring

  • A background in marketing operations, CRM operations, marketing technology or customer insight
  • Hands-on experience of a platform such as Iterable, HubSpot, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Braze or Klaviyo
  • Confidence with segmentation, lifecycle reporting and attribution
  • Experience of consent and data governance in a marketing setting
  • The ability to take a business ask and turn it into a spec technical teams can build from

job.title: Head of CX & Marketing (Scale up brand)
job.description:
Head of Marketing and CX


Central London, hybrid (3 days a week in the office)


£85,000 to £105,000 plus 20% bonus


A growing UK business with plans to become a household name is hiring a Head of Marketing to lead marketing and communications through its next stage of growth.


The business is scaling quickly, opening new locations and growing its app and digital services. You will set the marketing strategy, the plan and the measures, and lead a team of 5 to deliver across consumer, business and corporate audiences.


What you will be responsible for


• Marketing strategy, the annual plan and the campaign calendar

• Awareness, acquisition and growth across digital and physical channels

• PR, external communications and employer brand

• Defining and embedding the customer value proposition

• Launch marketing for new locations and new digital features

• B2B marketing and growing partnership income

• KPIs and monthly reporting, so spend shows a clear return

• Leading a team of 5 and managing the agency partners


About you


This role is number 2 to a member of the executive team, with influence beyond your remit. You will bring:


• Senior marketing leadership, with ownership of strategy, budget, people and results

• A track record of growing a brand, ideally through a scale-up or challenger stage

• Structure and commercial focus. You talk in metrics, set a long-term plan and break it into yearly deliverables

• Strength in digital, CRM and social, plus PR and communications. Retail experience is welcome

• A knack for making a modest budget work hard, and for making the case for more

• The confidence to challenge, hold the line on the brand and deputise for your manager

• A visible leader who wants to be in the office with a growing London team

• A marketing qualification (CIM or equivalent) is preferred, or an MBA backed by a successful marketing career


The package


• £85,000 to £110,000 base salary

• 20% bonus

• 25 days holiday plus bank holidays, and your birthday off

• 5% employer pension

• 3 days a week in a central London office, on days you choose

• Flexible start and finish times (core 9-6)


The role needs regular presence in central London, so you will need to live within a reasonable commute.

job.title: Head of Customer
job.description:
Head of Site, Customer Contact Centre


Greater Manchester | Permanent | £75,000 plus benefits | On site with some global travel


A global B2B2C business runs customer support on behalf of banks and financial services firms around the world. Those corporate clients hand over their own customers, and this operation looks after them 24/7, in several languages, by phone, email, chat and social messaging. Manchester is the UK site within a global support model, working alongside teams and outsourced partners in other regions.


The clients are regulated, so the work is too. Complaints handling, fair treatment of customers in vulnerable circumstances and data protection are part of the day job, and each corporate client holds the site to its own contracted service levels.


The business is changing how it supports customers. Channels, technology and partners are all under review, and the Head of Site will lead Manchester through that change while keeping service steady for clients who expect results every week.


The role

  • Lead the Manchester contact centre, including the managers and team leaders who run each shift and each language team.
  • Own performance against every corporate client’s SLAs, and be the person those clients call when results slip.
  • Run a multichannel operation on Zendesk, using its reporting, routing and workflows to improve how contacts are handled.
  • Lead the site through a transformation programme covering channel mix, tooling, processes and ways of working.
  • Shape how this site fits into the global model, working with regional sites and outsourced partners so a customer gets the same standard of service in any language or market.
  • Keep the site compliant with client and regulatory requirements, and ready for audit at any point.
  • Onboarding new corporate clients into the operation, from forecasting and resourcing to training and go-live.
  • Build the leadership bench beneath you through coaching, succession planning and clear performance management.
  • Travel overseas from time to time to work with global colleagues and partner sites.
  • Report to the VP of Global Customer Support and contribute to global strategy.


About you

  • You have run a contact centre site, or a large part of one, with managers reporting to you.
  • You have delivered service on behalf of corporate clients against contracted SLAs, in a B2B2C or outsourced setting.
  • You have led multilingual or multi-market teams. A second language is welcome but not required.
  • You know Zendesk well, or another major CX platform to the point where you could pick it up quickly.
  • You have led change in a live operation and can show the before and after in numbers.
  • You have worked in a regulated sector such as financial services, payments, utilities or telecoms.
  • You are comfortable in a global business where some calls happen outside UK hours.


What’s on offer

  • Salary of £75,000
  • Annual performance bonus
  • 28 days holiday plus bank holidays
  • Private medical cover
  • Life assurance
  • Travel expenses covered for overseas trips
  • Funded training and professional development
  • On-site parking and good transport links into Manchester
  • A senior seat in a global business, with a direct line to the global leadership team

job.title: Customer Journey Consultant
job.description:
Interim CX Consultant: Customer Journey Redesign

Yorkshire, 3 days per week on site | Start late October 2026 | Day rate on experience

A privately owned business has grown quickly, and its customer journey has grown piece by piece alongside it. They now want it mapped as one journey and rebuilt.

The assignment

  • Map the current journey end to end, across every route a customer arrives by.
  • Design the future journey, moving the team towards proactive contact.
  • Find the friction and the duplicated steps, and remove tasks that no longer need doing.
  • Write the process maps and procedures that sit behind the new journey, with metrics underneath.
  • Work side by side with a CRM developer joining the business, so the new workflows are built as you design them.

How you will work

You will sit with the customer care team, watch how the work is done and write it up yourself. Your first 2 weeks produce the current picture and a roadmap, with the quick wins first. The business wants to move fast, so pace counts.

About you

  • You have taken a customer journey from first map to launch and can show what changed.
  • You look at the journey as a whole and question whether each step needs to exist.
  • You are comfortable in a growing business without big project teams around you.
  • Experience in a regulated sector is useful.

job.title: Head of Customer Insight
job.description:
Customer Insight Lead


Social housing | Hybrid, Liverpool | £60,000


Turn data that is rich but siloed into something the whole business can make decisions on.


The organisation holds plenty of rich information on its service users: contact reasons, complaints, repairs history, satisfaction survey results, digital journeys. It sits in separate places and rarely gets used together. This role brings it into one picture and puts it in front of the people making decisions, across the customer function and the wider business.


What you'll do

  • Bring together what the organisation holds on service users across every channel, digital and otherwise, and turn it into evidence decision makers can use
  • Break down the gaps between data sources, so contact, complaints, repairs and survey data get read as one picture rather than several
  • Work across the customer function and the wider business: finance, operations, and the board, not just the team that owns customer experience
  • Sit on the new residents committee, bringing evidence into a forum where tenants have a direct say in the decisions that affect them
  • Keep pace with the regulatory environment shaping the sector and translate what it means for the numbers you own
  • Build the case for a decision on evidence rather than instinct, and hold that line in rooms where the instinct is strong


Our ideal applicant

  • Objective. You follow the data to its conclusion even when it is inconvenient
  • Commercially minded, able to connect service user data to decisions with a cost or a return attached, not only to satisfaction scores
  • Has broken down data silos before, and knows what it takes to get different systems and teams working from the same picture
  • Understands the regulatory pressures shaping social housing today, and what they mean operationally, not just for compliance reporting
  • Comfortable holding data from several sources at once: digital platforms, phone contact, home visits, complaints, surveys
  • An individual contributor by choice, confident presenting findings to people well outside the customer function, including residents themselves


The package

  • £60,000 base salary
  • Hybrid, based in Liverpool a few days a week
  • Benefits detail shared on application

﻿

All applications are handled confidentially by Stellify.

job.title: Customer Service & Insights Manager
job.description:
Customer Insight and Performance Manager


Liverpool (office based) | £40,000 to £44,000 including car allowance


Own performance, insight and regulatory compliance for a small, regulated property business where reporting goes all the way to Board. This role is the organisation's eyes: what's working, what's at risk, and what the data says should change.


The remit is broad for the size of business, and that's the appeal. You'll build the performance framework rather than inherit one, and your reporting will sit in front of Board and leadership every cycle.


What you'll own

  • The performance and insight framework: designing it, running it, and making it the way the business understands itself
  • Regulatory compliance and assurance: monitoring statutory and regulatory requirements, coordinating reporting for regulatory returns, internal reviews and external audits
  • Board reporting: papers, dashboards and exception reports that hold up to scrutiny
  • Customer complaints and feedback analysis, turned into recommendations that change how services run
  • Contractor and partner performance: KPIs, SLAs, and the meetings where accountability actually happens
  • Business systems and data improvement: better data quality, simpler workflows, and supporting new systems from testing through to training
  • Line management of a Compliance Officer, plus mentoring apprentices


Our ideal applicant

  • A customer-led performance leader: uses insight, complaints and service data to improve customers' experience, and can show where it worked
  • Strong on statutory and regulatory compliance, and confident being the person the organisation relies on to stay ahead of it
  • Skilled at data interrogation and analysis, and clearer still at explaining what the numbers mean to a Board
  • Comfortable challenging contractors and partners while keeping the relationship working


The package

  • £40,000 to £45,000, including car allowance
  • 35 hours, Monday to Friday, with flexi time
  • Office based in Liverpool
  • Pension with employer contribution
  • 25 days holiday plus bank holidays


All applications are handled confidentially by Stellify.
